exposure: Type of delivery (induction of labor vs. elective cesarean section)
outcome: Accuracy of sonographic AC measurement compared to neonatal anthropometry
Accuracy of sonographic AC measurement compared to standard ultrasound estimations of fetal weight
cohort: 52 women with term, singleton gestations undergoing induction of labor or elective caesarean section at a tertiary referral centre
finding: Sonographic abdominal circumference measurement is accurate in term pregnancies, with a percentage error less than head circumference or estimated fetal weight.
